description.en: Official DeepSeek Harness plugin bundles published on npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方发布在 npm 上的插件组合包。

description.en: Provide automation-only ACP communication and process lifecycle management over dsh-base.
description.zh: 在 dsh-base 上提供自动化专用的 ACP 通信与进程生命周期。

description.en: Upload a chat export ZIP from the DeepSeek website with the button next to New session; each conversation becomes a session in the workspace you choose.
description.zh: 点击“新建会话”旁的按钮上传 DeepSeek 官网导出的 ZIP 文件，每段对话都会成为所选工作区中的一个会话。

description.en: Adds an Auto review access mode: before each tool call, a model checks it against what you asked for, runs allowed calls at once, and holds denied calls for your approval.
description.zh: 提供“自动审查”访问模式：每次工具调用前，由模型对照你的要求检查，获准的调用立即运行，被拒绝的调用等你审批。

description.en: Open the running Host and its browser Clients in Chrome DevTools through a loopback endpoint that allows code execution and captures Host network traffic, including secrets. For developers; Web only; reload open pages after enabling.
description.zh: 通过一个允许执行代码并捕获 Host 网络请求（含密钥）的本机回环端点，在 Chrome DevTools 中检查运行中的 Host 及其浏览器 Client。面向开发者；仅 Web 可用；启用后需刷新已打开的页面。

description.en: Ask for work on a new branch, and the agent creates a separate Git worktree and continues there, leaving your current checkout as it is.
description.zh: 要求在新分支上工作时，智能体会创建单独的 Git 工作树并在其中继续，你当前的工作树保持原样。

description.en: Run a single task directly with the core Agent/Session runner over dsh-base, without a Host, HTTP, or browser layer.
description.zh: 在 dsh-base 上直接使用核心 Agent/Session 执行单次任务，不包含 Host、HTTP 或浏览器层。

description.en: Provide JSON-RPC over standard input and output and manage the process lifecycle over dsh-base.
description.zh: 在 dsh-base 上提供标准输入输出 JSON-RPC 与进程生命周期管理。

description.en: Delegate one task to Claude Code using its native authentication and settings.
description.zh: 使用 Claude Code 原生认证和设置委派单个任务。

description.en: Delegate one task to Codex using its native authentication and settings.
description.zh: 使用 Codex 原生认证和设置委派单个任务。

description.en: The dsh browser-surface bundle: the web patch layer over dsh-base plus the runtime glue plugin (frontend dist serving, bash runtime variables, URL line)
description.zh: 提供前端页面资源，并连接 Web 应用所需的运行配置。
